items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: I love Louie because I remember a long time ago when Louie played a lot of records out of the youngster and I used to try to imitate Louie.

ctx.x: I'm not sure if it's next week or when it'll be, if the next part may be next week.
Well I'll look for that because I love Louie.
He didn't play, he just talked, told about the old times here.
